description: Check Base Chainlink 24/5 US equity feeds used by Aave V4 Coinbase Stocks (TSLAc, NVDAc, AAPLc). Reports the latest round timestamp, whether oracles should be frozen (Friday 20:00–Sunday 20:00 ET), and flags anomaly=weekend_update if a feed updated during that freeze (possible move to 24/7). US market holidays are not on this clock. Uses Base RPC (set BASE_RPC_URL; public fallbacks are tried).

asOf.description: ISO time to evaluate the freeze window; default now

name: get_oracle_status
